label: Spread
short: Staff who did real work with AI last week, counted.
strong: Most staff did real work with a tool last week. Team mode shows how deep.
middle: About half, or fewer. Team mode shows who, and that is the next step.
edge: Nobody did real work with a tool last week. Start with one person and one task: talk to a listed person.
unmet: Run team mode. It is the only honest way to know.
